pattern.title: When the Signal Is Not About the World
pattern.before: Insight production depended on continuous feeds of web-search evidence with source-level attribution, allowing each candidate signal to be matched against an existing process thesis.
pattern.shift: The August 9 dossier arrived as an abstract summary without any independent, verifiable, source-attributed facts — a meta-signal about evidence collection rather than about any real-world process.
pattern.now: The candidate correctly identifies itself as an evidence gap. No process judgment can change, and all four registered processes remain at their last-assessed stages with zero material-change score.
pattern.conclusion: This is a temporary evidence-collection failure, not a global process insight. Re-collection of evidence with full source attribution is required before any process judgment is updated.

insight.title: Evidence integrity is the prerequisite for process tracking
insight.formula: No source-level facts → No validation → No process update
insight.explanation: When the evidence dossier lacks URLs, publishers, dates, and verifiable facts, the signal pipeline cannot produce meaningful process updates — regardless of how plausible the abstract claim may sound.

pattern.title: 当信号与真实世界无关时
pattern.before: 洞察生产依赖于持续输入的、带有源级归属的网络搜索证据，从而使每个候选信号都能与现有进程论点进行匹配。
pattern.shift: 8月9日的档案以抽象摘要的形式出现，没有任何独立、可验证、可追溯来源的事实——这是一个关于证据收集的元信号，而非关于任何真实世界进程。
pattern.now: 该候选信号正确地识别出自身是一个证据缺口。任何进程判断都无法改变，四个已登记进程均停留在最近一次评估的阶段，实质性变化评分为零。
pattern.conclusion: 这是一个临时的证据收集失败，而非全球进程洞察。在更新任何进程判断之前，需要重新收集带有完整来源归属的证据。

insight.title: 证据完整性是进程追踪的前提
insight.formula: 无源级事实 → 无法验证 → 无法更新进程
insight.explanation: 当证据档案缺少URL、发布机构、日期和可验证事实时，无论抽象论断听起来多么合理，信号管道都无法产生有意义的进程更新。

items.whyImportant: ソースレベルの詳細がなければ、いかなるプロセス論も更新できず、独立した検証も不可能である。

pattern.title: シグナルが世界の変化についてでない場合
pattern.before: これまでインサイトの生成は、ソースレベルの帰属を備えたウェブ検索エビデンスの継続的な供給に依存しており、各候補シグナルを既存のプロセス論と照合することができた。
pattern.shift: 8月9日の資料は、独立した検証可能なソース帰属を伴わない抽象的な要約として到着した。これは実世界のプロセスについてではなく、エビデンス収集についてのメタシグナルである。
pattern.now: この候補は、それ自体がエビデンスの欠落であると正しく認識している。プロセスの判定は何も変わらず、登録済みの4プロセスはすべて前回評価時の段階のままであり、物質的変化スコアはゼロである。
pattern.conclusion: これは一時的なエビデンス収集の失敗であり、グローバルプロセスのインサイトではない。プロセス判定を更新する前に、完全なソース帰属を備えたエビデンスの再収集が必要である。

insight.title: エビデンスの完全性はプロセス追跡の前提条件である
insight.formula: ソースレベルの事実なし → 検証なし → プロセス更新なし
insight.explanation: エビデンス資料にURL、発行元、日付、検証可能な事実がない場合、抽象的な主張がどれほどもっともらしく聞こえても、シグナルパイプラインは意味のあるプロセス更新を生み出すことができない。

researchDraft.querySummary: The search dossier lists three unverified candidate signals from the past 24 hours: the July CPI/PPI release, an apparent Beijing property purchase relaxation, and US chip export-control news. Of these, the Beijing property policy relaxation is the most direct potential input to the existing China property and local-finance transition process, but the dossier does not include independent source details, so evidence strength is low and this is a draft signal pending verification.

en.title: Beijing relaxes property purchase restrictions
en.coreFact: Beijing announced a relaxation of property purchase restrictions on 2026-08-09, adding the capital to the latest round of local housing demand-support measures. The dossier flags this as one of the most significant China signals in the past 24 hours, though no numeric or legal details were confirmed.
en.whyItMatters: Beijing is the policy-signaling city for the national housing market and one of the last major cities to hold strict purchase restrictions. A relaxation here could support turnover in the capital, influence home-price expectations nationwide, and feed into local fiscal capacity during the property-to-new-finance transition.
en.processMatchReason: This signal directly modifies the China property and local-finance transition process by altering demand-side conditions in the most policy-sensitive housing market and potentially affecting local fiscal revenue, land sales, and the pace of balance-sheet adjustment.

zh.title: 北京放松房地产购买限制
zh.coreFact: 2026年8月9日，北京宣布放松房地产购买限制，成为本轮地方楼市需求支持措施的最新一环。研究备忘将其列为过去24小时内最可能影响中国进程判断的重要信号之一，但具体数据与政策细节尚未确认。
zh.whyItMatters: 北京是全国楼市最具政策信号意义的城市，也是少数仍执行严格限购的主要城市。放松限购可能提振首都住房成交、影响全国房价预期，并在房地产向新财政模式转型的过程中为地方财政能力提供支撑。
zh.processMatchReason: 该信号直接作用于“中国房地产与地方财政转型”进程：改变最具政策敏感性的楼市需求端条件，并可能影响地方财政收入、土地出让和资产负债表修复的节奏。

ja.title: 北京が不動産購入規制を緩和
ja.coreFact: 2026年8月9日、北京は不動産購入規制の緩和を発表し、地方都市による住宅需要支援策の最新の動きとなった。調査メモでは過去24時間で中国のプロセス判断を変え得る重要シグナルの一つとされるが、数値や規制の詳細は未確認。

question.lead: Amid China's property downturn and local government fiscal stress, how significant is Beijing's move to ease purchase curbs?
question.title: Is Beijing's Property Policy Shift a Turning Point for China's Housing Market?
question.footnote: Based on unconfirmed reports on August 9, 2026.

signals.title: Signals
signals.sourceNote: Sources are internal research dossiers due to limited public confirmation.

items.label: Policy announcement
items.title: Beijing relaxes property purchase restrictions
items.body: On August 9, 2026, reports indicate that Beijing announced a relaxation of property purchase restrictions, adding the capital to the latest round of local housing demand-support measures. Specific numeric or legal details remain unconfirmed.
items.whyImportant: Beijing serves as the policy-signaling city for the national housing market. A relaxation here could support turnover in the capital, influence home-price expectations nationwide, and affect local fiscal revenue and land sales.

items.label: Process context
items.title: China's property-to-new-finance transition
items.body: China's local governments have historically relied on land sales and property taxes for revenue. The ongoing property downturn has strained local budgets, prompting a structural shift toward new fiscal models.
items.whyImportant: Understanding Beijing's policy move requires the context of the broader transition away from property-driven local finance, which is still in flux.

evidence.title: China process register – property and local finance
evidence.description: Internal knowledge base describing the structural transition and current stage.

pattern.title: From Property Dependence to Fiscal Rebalancing
pattern.before: Local governments relied heavily on land sales and property taxes; Beijing maintained strict purchase restrictions to cool the market.
pattern.shift: The property market downturn exposes local fiscal vulnerabilities, prompting a gradual shift toward new revenue sources and demand-side support.
pattern.now: Beijing joins other cities in relaxing purchase curbs, signaling official acceptance of the need to stabilize the market, even as the fiscal transition remains incomplete.
pattern.conclusion: The relaxation reflects a structural pivot where housing policy increasingly serves broader economic stability and fiscal adjustment, rather than solely controlling speculation.

insight.title: Beijing's property relaxation is a structural signal
insight.formula: Policy-signaling capital + demand support → faster price expectation adjustment + local fiscal breathing room
insight.explanation: Beijing's move, if confirmed, accelerates the normalization of housing market support across China, reducing tail risk for local finance and potentially anchoring a floor for home prices, thereby facilitating the transition to a new fiscal model.

items.label: 进程背景
items.title: 中国从房地产到新财政的转型
items.body: 中国地方政府历来依赖土地出让和房地产相关税收获取收入。当前房地产下行给地方预算带来压力，促使向新财政模式的结构性转变。
items.whyImportant: 理解北京政策举措需要结合从房地产驱动型地方财政的广泛转型背景，该转型仍在进行中。

pattern.title: 从房地产依赖到财政再平衡
pattern.before: 地方政府严重依赖土地出让与房地产税收；北京维持严格限购为市场降温。
pattern.shift: 房地产下行暴露地方财政脆弱性，促使逐步转向新收入来源和需求侧支持。
pattern.now: 北京加入其他城市放松限购，表明官方接受稳定市场的必要性，尽管财政转型仍未完成。
pattern.conclusion: 放松限购反映了结构性转向：住房政策日渐服务于更广泛的经济稳定与财政调整，而非单纯抑制投机。

insight.explanation: 北京的行动若得到证实，将加速全国楼市支持政策的常态化，降低地方财政尾部风险，并可能为房价构筑底部，从而推动向新财政模式的转型。
